settings.heading: Corporate Team Building
settings.subheading: Build stronger teams through hands-on bamboo bicycle workshops

settings.text: Bring your team together for a unique, hands-on experience that combines creativity, collaboration, and sustainability. Our corporate workshops are designed to build more than bicycles – they build teamwork, communication, and lasting memories.

settings.title: Collaboration
settings.text: Teams work together on real projects with tangible outcomes, building communication and trust.

settings.title: Creativity
settings.text: Hands-on making encourages creative thinking and problem-solving in a new context.

settings.title: CSR Impact
settings.text: Align your event with sustainability values. Bikes can be donated to charity programmes.
We've delivered team building workshops for Four Seasons Hotel, London Design Festival, and many more forward-thinking companies who value creativity, sustainability, and meaningful experiences.

settings.title: Half-Day Introduction
settings.text:
Duration: 3-4 hours
Group Size: 6-20 people
Outcome: Build balance bike kits as a team
Perfect for: Shorter team events, introduction to bamboo building

settings.title: Full-Day Build
settings.text:
Duration: Full day
Group Size: 4-12 people
Outcome: Complete bamboo bicycle frame per person
Perfect for: Intensive team experiences, CSR initiatives

Make your team event even more meaningful. Bikes built during corporate workshops can be donated to our Build to Bond prison programme, where they're given to children of incarcerated parents.

This creates a lasting CSR impact while delivering a memorable team experience.
